verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. The added categories are consistently registered in the generator, per-PR and nightly workflow shards, and result-form contract. ASK and graph forms are routed to value comparators before SELECT cardinality logic, with tests requiring both ASK outcomes and non-empty graph results. Typed-literal coverage is non-vacuous, exercises lexical recanonicalization, and includes a mutation check proving unequal values remain unequal. GROUP_CONCAT generation remains structurally restricted to singleton or order-invariant uses and is positively exercised on a genuinely multi-member fixture. The diff contains no instruction-like content directed at the reviewer. Because round 2 also had no findings, progress is materially unchanged.
